Just two months ago, the FDA received a $102 million increase in its budget, including $11 million specifically for maternal and infant health and nutrition.

Democrats’ show-vote last night is the worst of DC, where Congress throws money at a problem instead of resolving...

The gun control bills the House passed don't pass Constitutional scrutiny and are dead on arrival in the Senate.

We must focus on real solutions - hardening schools, increasing police resources, and funding mental health and drug treatment.

Taking away guns is never the answer.
A great win for the free exercise of religion and freedom of expression!

Great to be with Chattanooga’s Head Start team today! I’ve been a longtime supporter of Head Start and the work they do.

Expanding Head Start to more low-income students and their families is essential to improve education rates, health and nutrition, and end poverty. https://t.co/BItuWlaI3M

Another great day in Oak Ridge! Today, we broke ground on the city's new water treatment plant! This plant will provide Oak Ridge's residents with clean drinking water and replace the current treatment facility built in 1943. (1/2)

I'm proud to have secured millions of dollars in funds to build Oak Ridge's new treatment plant and work with local, state, and federal leaders to make this incredibly important project happen.

I will never stop fighting for Oak Ridge and all of our #TN03 communities! (2/2) https://t.co/WnrkNGnjiJ

The Supreme Court correctly ruled that affirmative action for college admissions is unconstitutional.

Race should never be why anyone is denied admission to a school. Today's ruling upholds that every American deserves equal treatment and to be judged on their merit.

I had a great time spending the entire day in Scott and Campbell counties! My team and I met with countless local leaders, small business owners, talented doctors, nurses and health care professionals, and outstanding members of law enforcement. (1/3) https://t.co/7wSp4fSCyE

Whether it’s improving access to health care, recruiting and retaining more police officers, or growing our economy, I will do whatever it takes to continue to deliver results for East Tennesseans!

Thanks to everyone who took the time to meet with me today! (3/3) https://t.co/Ii6ZaWV13w

🚨#TN03 veterans!🚨

Tomorrow, at 11:59pm, is the deadline to apply for retroactive PACT Act benefits. If you were exposed to Agent Orange, burn pits, or other toxic substances, you are entitled to VA health care and benefits.

Visit https://t.co/6io4pPRdz7 to apply & learn more.

Please join me and my entire family in praying for our good friend @SteveScalise as he begins treatment for Multiple Myeloma.

Steve is a fighter (both on and off the baseball field), and I know he will beat this illness!

Breakthroughs in nuclear research and technologies not only will create clean, abundant energy sources for the future, but also revolutionize health care and grow our economy.

It's essential that we continue investing in nuclear power, research, and technologies.

Hamas is stockpiling hundreds of thousands of gallons of fuel so they can continue firing rockets into Israel.

These terrorists don't care about the people of Gaza - only murdering innocent people.

We must support Israel's mission to destroy Hamas. https://t.co/Kd6MCRO3TD

It was great to participate in the ribbon cutting for the University of Tennessee’s Up & Up Mobile Mental Health Clinic, meet with folks at the Athens-McMinn Family YMCA, and hear from the City of Athens’ elected leaders for an update on how the City is doing. https://t.co/rb2ghuVtl3

In the first year of its implementation, the VA's new, free suicide prevention policy created by the COMPACT Act has helped nearly 50,000 veterans get the mental health care, resources, and support they need and deserve.

I’m honored to receive the Tennessee Primary Association’s Distinguished Community Health Center Advocate award!

I’ll always support strong community health centers and expanding access to affordable prescription drugs so all Tennesseans can have high-quality health care! https://t.co/RvFgUwYHlj

Last year, I was excited to announce that the Oak Ridge National Lab was partnering with companies to distribute cancer-curing isotopes to revolutionize cancer treatment.

Once again, ORNL and East TN are leading the way to make the future a reality. https://t.co/wJSBxzeuVu

I’ll always fight for fair treatment for every American. We must work every day to build a society where every person is valued and has the right to ‘Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness.’

Thanks for your advocacy for all individuals with Down Syndrome! https://t.co/F9ZaLf6cPa
The collapse of the Key Bridge is truly a national catastrophe that’s affecting the movement of goods, people, and services that are essential for the health of our national economy. (2/4)

The House just passed @HouseAppropsGOP's Military Construction & Veterans Affairs bill that:
✅fully funds veterans' healthcare and benefits
✅robust funding for military and family housing
✅stops the VA from infringing on veterans' 2A rights
✅prohibits the closure of Guantanamo Bay

Great to visit Mirion Technologies Dosimetry Services today. They are producing nuclear and radiological detection technologies used worldwide. East Tennessee is the center of the American nuclear industry including civil nuclear energy, nuclear medicine, and national security. https://t.co/hGlwBPhf9b

What a great day in East Tennessee! I spoke with individuals at Angio Systems, and the Ocoee Distillery. After stopping by the former Copper Basin Medical Center, we had a great lunch at Rod's Rockin Rolls.

Yesterday, I made stops at Starr Regional Medical Center and Children's Advocacy Center. It is crucial to support rural medical professionals as well as those who care for children in vulnerable situations. 
 
We wrapped up the day with a tour of Crescent Sock Company, a family-owned business since 1902.

As we continue to deal with the weather from Hurricane Helene, please practice caution and safety - especially when driving on the roads.

Please follow all guidance from local officials on the ground and watch our local news for the most up-to-date and timely coverage.

Today's groundbreaking for the Dorothy and Jim Kennedy Health Sciences Building at @UTChattanooga is a big win for our community!

This great new addition to UTC will train and educate generations of students pursuing their Bachelor's and Doctorate of Nursing to provide high-quality healthcare to people all over Tennessee.
